reason: The cited evidence states that the study investigates how dopant location and concentration impact catalytic activity (E2) and uses hot-injection synthesis to control Co loading and probe its effects on HDS (E3), but it does not provide prior results confirming that Co activates the basal plane, increases surface area, or enhances activity relative to undoped MoS2; these are the aims of the study, not established findings.
premises: Co dopant atoms activate the basal plane of MoS2 nanosheets
Dopant location and concentration can be controlled by hot-injection colloidal synthesis
Increased catalytic surface area from basal plane activation enhances HDS activity
Doped MoS2 nanosheets show higher HDS activity than undoped ones
The structure–activity relationship is probed by XAS and DFT
